name: Atom65 Profile Sync
author: Roy Ackerman
description: Dose-only Bluetooth driver for the custom Atom65 GBW controller. Each Decaid profile opts in separately; other profiles leave the grinder unchanged.

SyncEnabled.label: Enable profile dose syncing
SyncEnabled.description: Master switch. Only profiles you explicitly enable in Device settings can change the grinder. Turning this off cancels unsent updates.

MaximumDose.label: Maximum synced dose (g)
MaximumDose.description: Reject doses above this value instead of clamping them. Default 40 g; allowed range 5 to 1000 g, further limited by the controller's advertised range.
